action.prompt: Kiroween rules: the /.kiro directory (specs, hooks, steering) must never be gitignored or the submission is disqualified. Inspect the just-saved .gitignore. If it contains a pattern that would exclude .kiro or any of its children (e.g. a bare `.kiro` entry or an over-broad wildcard), flag it loudly to the user and propose a corrected .gitignore that keeps /.kiro tracked while preserving the user's intent for other paths.
